hero-tag: Association of Cuban Communities in the Federative Republic of Brazil
hero-title: Building a future together in Brazil
hero-subtitle: We provide legal, social and cultural support for the successful integration of Cubans.
about-desc: We are a community organization dedicated to supporting Cuban migrants and refugees in Brazil. We provide guidance, accompaniment, and access to essential resources, promoting social inclusion, respect for human rights, and a dignified life. We work to strengthen cultural, social, and economic integration, fostering solidarity and coexistence in Brazilian society.
projects-subtitle: Current and future projects for the Cuban community
p1-desc: Distribution of basic supplies and hygiene kits to newly arrived families.
p2-desc: Festivals and workshops that keep our Cuban heritage alive on Brazilian soil.
p3-desc: Portuguese courses and job insertion workshops for Cuban professionals.
mission-desc: To provide support, guidance, and accompaniment to Cuban migrants and refugees, promoting the protection of their human rights, social inclusion, and access to basic services, in order to guarantee dignified and safe living conditions.
vision-desc: To consolidate itself as a solid, transparent, and recognized community organization that effectively contributes to the social, cultural, and economic integration of Cuban migrants into Brazilian society, strengthening solidarity and intercultural coexistence.
values-desc: Solidarity, dignity, respect, inclusion, and commitment to the well-being of our community.
donate-desc: Every contribution goes directly to food packages and free legal advice.
footer-tagline: Working for the dignity and well-being of Cubans in Brazil. Building bridges of hope since 2024.
footer-copyright: © 2024 ACCRFB — Association of Cubans Residing in Brazil
mant-desc: We are working to bring you something amazing.
